changes_at_filing: Label: min(c, r) under the bar at every site is graded 'no carrying variable among the named ones' (H is named by hand), not 'no reading'; 'no reading' is kept for a gap under floor_gap (lead, 2026-11-12, from the P1.18 review). Meaning and thresholds unchanged.
Thresholds: bars, gap_tol, reload_tol and do_nothing_tol added under the names run.py reads; their values are the draft's (options, S2's 0.005, S1/R2_LOAD's 1e-4, S3's 1e-4).

RUN1_STOP's exact check names the items it covers (planted constant, planted trigger, floor, Always on, Cue, XOR: the edits written along Q b at in2, where V holds the whole write); Table is not an exact edit under either alignment (its write is full rank at in2, V is Q b or the answers' span at the last layer), so the draft's 'every hand-made edit' would have stopped run 1 on Table by construction.
Constant rule: SS <= constant_rel * sum Delta^2 needs sum Delta^2 > 0, so an all-zero Delta is not read as a constant (draft edge case 'Delta_all_zero_gap_positive').

A gain trigger (the key tables' and E137 Table-span's own unembedding row) is the input token itself, which no interchange can swap: the one-variable branch reads f_one alone there (i is null by construction). An activation trigger with no pair or beta 0 keeps the draft's rule: i not applicable, the one-variable grade is not given.
question: Under the third reuse wording (testing only, not adopted), read by interchange interventions through an alignment fixed on the plain 67M: do the planted controls read their constructed grades, does the twin's push follow the plain model's own parity variable while the memorised fact has none, and what grade does each old matched pair get under each map class and bar? Every reading is labelled 'under the third wording, provisional'; no change to decisions.md.

options_read_not_chosen.bar_note: one bar B used for carry, reversion, trigger interchange and fit shares together, read at each option; which holds is the user's
map_class: one-variable: own value plus a gain of at most one named trigger
per-token: plus a table of the task's token (equal here to the page's named-variables class, every pool but the case pool's 800 words fitting in 768 directions)
named-variables: own, trigger and a fitted read of the task token's embedding (block 0's input at its position); read on the case pair only, where it differs from per-token
alignment: one direction per variable (all E168-layout items, E137's four pieces along Q b, case, repeat)
span of an answer set's unembedding rows at the last layer, 'final' (key tables, 24 or 32 directions; E137 Table-span, 32)
options_read_not_chosen.sites: U at in2, in3, out3 (E168 and E137 layouts); V at final (old pairs, Table-span); the site with the largest min(c, r), ties to the earlier

threshold_sources.floor_gap: E139's filed floor, as E168 used it (built_control_sum/results/predictions_amend1.json)
threshold_sources.tol_exact: about 20 times the float floor of two runs of the 67M, 1.03e-5 in mean TV (built_control_sum/results/amend1_stage0.json floor_runs_tv), over a gap of about 0.23: 1 - c on an exact edit is expected near 5e-5
threshold_sources.constant_rel: float32 rounding of a constant shift: centred sum of squares at most 1e-6 of the uncentred
threshold_sources.n_pairs: E62/E55 used 500 pairs as the void floor; 20,000 gives a binomial-scale sd under 0.004 on a share
threshold_sources.i_card: the card's smallest_gap: halfway between follows (1) and ignores (0)
threshold_sources.gap_tol: E157's gap_tol for a calibrated planted edit
threshold_sources.reload_tol: E168's reload_tol for a rebuilt or reloaded F's gap
threshold_sources.do_nothing_tol: ten times the float floor of two runs of the 67M (1.03e-5)

noise_floor: Two runs of the 67M: mean TV 1.03e-5. Seed spread of i on the fine-tunes is not known before run 2; the card borrows the old tasks' G seed sd 0.04 as a proxy and run 2 reports i's own spread over 2 seeds.

expected_at.W0: a zero-step fine-tune is the 67M: gap 0, no reading (E154 zero_step_plain: mean and max TV 0)
expected_at.do_nothing: F = a copy of M's weights: gap 0 under floor_gap, no reading, before any ratio; it cannot pass any bar. The planted floor is the null of the fits: new computation at every bar option
expected_at.control: the planted trigger (P at in1 drives U at in2): c, r and i equal 1 within tol_exact at in2, f_one 1 within tol_exact, f_own under every bar: new trigger (one-variable class)

measures.gap: gap: mean TV between F and M at the last position on the read half
measures.c: cr[site].c = 1 - mean TV(M[V <- V_F], F) / gap
measures.r: cr[site].r = 1 - mean TV(F[V <- V_M], M) / gap
measures.site: site: the site of the largest min(c, r), ties to the earlier
measures.f_own, f_one, f_tok, f_named: fits['own' | 'one-variable' | 'per-token' | 'named-variables'].f: centred share of Delta = V_F - V_M at site, explained on the read half by least squares fitted on the fit half: own {1, V_M}; one-variable {1, V_M, trigger}; per-token {V_M, trigger, one-hot of the task token with a not-a-task-token column (spans the intercept)}; named-variables (case pair) {1, V_M, trigger, the task token's embedding}. A gain trigger is one scalar gain on the token's own unembedding row projected on V
measures.i: interchange.i: sum over pairs of sign(t'-t) (Delta_swap - Delta) / (beta * sum |t'-t|), beta = fits['one-variable'].beta; n_pairs seeded pairs of read windows with differing trigger class (opposite parity of the last number; cue in the window against not; the other case of the same word; the word seen earlier against not), the source's trigger written at the target's trigger site in F and in M; null where not applicable
measures.constant: fits['own'].ss and .sum_sq on the read half

rule.grade: grades[str(B)] at bar B: gap < floor_gap: 'no reading'. min(c, r) < B at every site: 'no carrying variable among the named ones'. At site: (sum_sq > 0 and ss <= constant_rel * sum_sq) or f_own >= B: 'pure re-setting'; else f_one >= B and (i >= B, or the trigger is a gain): 'new trigger (one-variable class)'; else (case pair) f_named >= B: 'new trigger (named-variables class)'; else f_tok >= B: 'new trigger (per-token class)'; else 'new computation'. A value exactly at B passes (1e-9 rounding)
rule.void: run1a.json void_bars: a bar the floor's f_one or f_tok reaches, or at which do_nothing's grade is not 'no reading'; void for every item
rule.label: every grade is reported as 'under the third wording, provisional' (each JSON's wording field), at each bar option and for each alignment option that applies

edge_cases.do_nothing: gap 0 caught first: no reading; cannot reach any ratio
edge_cases.SS_zero: a non-zero constant change: pure re-setting
edge_cases.Delta_all_zero_gap_positive: c = 0 under every bar: no carrying variable at that site; sum_sq 0 is not a constant
edge_cases.beta_zero_or_no_pairs: i not applicable (null): the one-variable grade is not given; the per-token branch is still read
edge_cases.gain_trigger: the key tables and Table-span: i null by construction, the one-variable branch reads f_one alone
edge_cases.ties: site ties to the earlier site; a share exactly at B passes
edge_cases.empty_class: no trigger direction: no trigger column, so the one-variable fit is the own fit and cannot pass where own did not
edge_cases.null_passes_bar: if the planted floor reaches f_one or f_tok at a bar option, or the do-nothing reads anything but no reading, that bar option is void for every item

blind_to: pushes in directions other than V that do not reach V by the last site read; changes spread over several variables; inputs outside each item's windows; values the inputs never produce under interchange
